scripts.init: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; cd "$(dirname "$npm_package_json")"; npx supabase@latest init'
scripts.link: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; cd "$(dirname "$npm_package_json")"; : "${SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF:?SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF is required}"; : "${SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN:?SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN is required}"; npx supabase@latest link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" --token "$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN"'
scripts.start: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; cd "$(dirname "$npm_package_json")"; npx supabase@latest start'
scripts.stop: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; cd "$(dirname "$npm_package_json")"; npx supabase@latest stop'
scripts.typecheck: echo 'No TypeScript sources yet in supabase package'
